name: CLIMB
description: CLIMB is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate clinical bias in large language models, assessing both intrinsic bias within the models and extrinsic bias on downstream clinical decision tasks. It introduces a novel metric, AssocMAD, and uses counterfactual interventions to measure disparities across demographic groups.
typical_sota_score: varies by task and CL setting (unknown)
reputation: A recent clinical bias benchmark that is relevant to fairness evaluation in healthcare NLP, but it has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: Focuses on measuring and mitigating clinical bias in LLMs; evaluates both intrinsic and extrinsic biases.
